habitat: Flocks on floodlands, estuaries, lakesides and farmlands.
summary: A locally common summer visitor, seen mostly in non-breeding plumage, when it lacks the black collar. Dark brown above, with a buff throat edged black, a buff breast, a white belly and rump, and entirely blackish underwings. It has less red on the gape than Collared Pratincole, and slightly more yellow-buff on the lower breast. Newman does not give a call. The stub has no Kemp estimate and none was added.

similar.note: Collared Pratincole has rufous underwing coverts and white-tipped secondaries. Black-winged Pratincole has entirely blackish underwings.

population.notes: No sourced Kruger estimate is currently available; taxonomy or later records require separate research.

head.pattern: Buff throat edged black. Non-breeding plumage lacks the black collar.

underparts.pattern: Slightly more yellow-buff on the lower breast than Collared Pratincole.

viewNotes.note: Dark brown above, buff throat edged black, and a white belly. The black collar is absent.
Buff throat and breast, white belly.
Dark brown upper parts and a white rump.
Black underwings, a buff breast and a white belly.

calls.description: Newman’s species page does not describe the voice. Grade A call and flight call from Mkhombo Dam, Mpumalanga. The filename names Black-winged Pratincole.

research.note: Newman calls it a summer visitor and does not name the months, so monthsPresent was left unset. Breeding plumage is mentioned only as the plumage with the black collar, so only non-breeding marks were stored. The stub has no Kemp block and no estimate, and both were left that way.
